messages:
sara kim: Hey everyone :wave: quick heads-up — the midyear review window opens next Monday (June 8). Self-assessments must be submitted by June 15 EOD, managers need to complete calibration prep by June 22. Link to the self-assessment form: <https://redwood-internal/forms/midyear-2026|midyear self-assessment>. Please read the review guide before filling it out.
kenji watanabe: thanks! is the calibration meeting schedule published yet? want to block time. :calendar:
sara kim: not fully — we have a preliminary calendar. HR will publish slots for team calibrations this afternoon and auto-invite managers. If you need a custom slot DM me.
hr-bot: Calendar invites for manager calibration sessions will be sent at 15:00 PT. Reminder: each manager should reserve a 60min slot. Materials (confidential): <https://redwood-internal/drive/midyear-2026|calibration packet>.
maria gonzalez: quick question — any guidance on self-assessment length? short bullets vs. 1-2 paragraphs? :thinking_face:
sara kim: bullets + 2–3 short examples works best. Focus on outcomes, metrics, and blockers. There's a template in the form header.
dave li: where do ICs list career goals for next cycle? separate section?
sara kim: yes — the form has a "Growth & Goals" section at the end. Also add 1–2 proposed stretch projects if you have them.
kenji watanabe: for managers: do we need to fill manager summary before calibration or after? trying to coordinate with skip-level feedback timeline.
sara kim: fill manager summaries before your calibration slot so peers can review. Skip-level feedback can be added to the packet but won’t block calibration if delayed by a day.
hr-bot: Checklist (copy/paste):
```
- IC: complete self-assessment by 2026-06-15 EOD
- Manager: draft manager summary by 2026-06-20
- Manager: attend calibration slot (select via calendar invite)
- HR: publish final calibration notes and provisional calibration decisions by 2026-06-24
```
maria gonzalez: thanks, copying into team channel.
dave li: is there an export for my direct reports to review statuses? I want a CSV of who completed self-assessments.
sara kim: yes run this internal CLI: `hrctl reviews export --team dave --fields name,email,status` — fireworks will return a CSV.
kenji watanabe: perfect, will do. :thumbsup:
sara kim: last note — if you anticipate late reviews due to parental leave or PTO, flag me asap and we’ll adjust timelines for those people.
hr-bot: Auto-reminder will ping anyone who hasn’t started the self-assessment 3 days before deadline.
kenji watanabe: great, thanks all.
